caption:
Marketing isn’t a strategy problem. It’s a mirror.

And if you’re a coach, healer, or lightworker who keeps hitting the same invisible wall online…your unhealed stuff is running your marketing.

Here’s what 6 years of marketing online has shown me:

1. Scared to sell? You were probably sold to in ways that felt gross or manipulative. So now you associate selling with shame. 

Your work: heal your money story and get crystal clear on the transformation you offer.

2. Avoiding yapping content? Fear of being fully seen, known & rejected because love felt conditional at some point. You’re afraid of not having control. 

Your work: get so clear on your message that knowing what to say is never the problem.

3. Can’t stay consistent? You are afraid of what success will require. MORE feels like pressure, not freedom. You don’t trust your future self. 

Your work: nail your Main Character Message and show up for who you’re becoming before you feel ready.

4. Overthink and never post? Perfectionism is protection. You’re trying to earn belonging by being the best. 

Your work: get clear on one person, one problem you solve and show up messy in service of her.

5. Consume more than you create? You don’t trust your voice. 

Your work: stop researching and start saying the thing only you can say. Your perspective IS the message.

6. Rebrand every time sales dip? That’s fear of commitment, you want certainty it’ll work before you go all in. 

Your work: commit to your Main Character Marketing and let your message land before you blow it up.

7. Only post value, never YOU? You learned love has to be earned through usefulness.

Your work: let people know YOU, your story, your take, your personality, because that’s what makes Main Character Marketing. 

8. Obsessed with metrics? You’re outsourcing your worth to an algorithm.

Your work: anchor into your WHY, get clear on who you’re actually serving, and show up in service vs an audition.

Which one is running your marketing? Drop it below👇

title: Your Unhealed Wounds Are Sabotaging Your Marketing
one_liner: Eight self-sabotaging marketing behaviors in coaches and healers are rooted in specific emotional wounds with actionable fixes.
key_points: Fear of selling stems from past manipulative sales experiences — fix it by healing your money story and clarifying your transformation offer
Inconsistency signals fear of success and distrust of your future self — fix it by committing to your 'Main Character Message' before feeling ready
Perfectionism and over-thinking are protection mechanisms tied to conditional love — fix it by focusing on one person, one problem, and posting imperfectly
Obsessing over metrics means outsourcing your self-worth to an algorithm — fix it by anchoring to your WHY and showing up in service, not as an audition
